title: Regularised RL improves sim-to-real transfer
abstract: arXiv:2610.32855v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Regularised reinforcement learning (RL) has provable robustness guarantees that should ease the transfer of policies from simulation to robots, known as sim-to-real. Yet, weakly regularised algorithms like Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) remain the de facto choice in sim-to-real pipelines, while the practical benefits of regularisation for transfer remain poorly characterised. In this work, we study the sim-to-real performance of commonly used RL algorithms, with the aim of characterising the effects of regularisation on robotic performance. To that end, we derive Soft MellowMax Actor-Critic (SMM-AC), a novel regularised RL algorithm based on the soft mellowmax value function, which carries strong robustness guarantees. On MuJoCo continuous control benchmarks, SMM-AC is competitive with baselines like Soft Actor-Critic (SAC). translated_title: 正则化强化学习改善仿真到现实的迁移
translated_abstract: 正则化强化学习（RL）具有可证明的鲁棒性保证，理应促进策略从仿真到机器人的迁移（即sim-to-real）。然而，像近端策略优化（PPO）这类弱正则化算法仍然是sim-to-real流程中事实上的标准选择，而正则化对迁移的实际益处至今仍缺乏充分的刻画。在本工作中，我们研究了常用RL算法的sim-to-real性能，旨在刻画正则化对机器人性能的影响。为此，我们推导出了Soft MellowMax Actor-Critic（SMM-AC），这是一种基于软mellowmax价值函数的新型正则化RL算法，具有强鲁棒性保证。在MuJoCo连续控制基准测试中，SMM-AC与软演员-评论家（SAC）等基线方法相比具有竞争力。在真实机器人上，SMM-AC获得了更高的回报，同时对观测中的扰动表现出更强的鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文提出基于软mellowmax价值函数的新型正则化强化学习算法SMM-AC，该算法在真实机器人上比SAC等基线方法获得更高回报且抗扰动能力更强，证明了正则化能够有效改善sim-to-real迁移性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SMM-AC, a novel regularised RL algorithm based on the soft mellowmax value function, which achieves higher returns and greater robustness to perturbations on real robots than baselines like SAC, demonstrating that regularisation effectively improves sim-to-real transfer.
